name: Chinese traditions
summary: A cluster comprising Confucianism, Taoism and Chinese folk religion, whose boundaries in practice are porous.
contested_note: The spec flags the classification of this cluster, and of Confucianism in particular, as a religion rather than a philosophy or a civic tradition. Both positions require citation before this note ships.

adherents.note: Formal zongjiao identification in the PRC runs at about 10% across all religions per Pew 2025, while scholarly estimates of folk religious practice run to hundreds of millions. The note stands in place of a point estimate. Taiwan is the one polity Pew records as majority "other religions".
